$schema_draft_comment: Candidate specification and semantic walk-through for protocol v2. NOT a frozen schema or executed experiment. All paths/parameters are candidate hypotheses only.

research_task._task_content_hash_reason: Hash calculation excludes task_content_hash itself; null in unexecuted draft.
research_task.title: 国内商品期货跨期期限结构展期收益率20日截面相关性候选走查
research_task.objective: 检验基于官方结算价构建的年化展期收益率 (Annualized Roll Yield) 对主力合约未来20日向前对数收益率的截面统计相关性与分层单调性特征（候选走查样例，非通用参数规定）。
research_task.hypothesis: 期限结构处于现货溢价 (Backwardation) 状态的品种，在未来20日持有期内表现出截面统计上的正向收益相关性；该假设为待检验的经验假说，非必然因果推论。
research_task.expected_edge: 在20日预测期内，展期收益率因子的截面秩相关系数 (Rank IC) 样本均值期望大于 0，且分层组合表现出正向收益利差。

data_requirements.pit_constraints: Daily settlement prices and open interests are available strictly after actual exchange release timestamps. Unverified availability timestamps block execution. Evaluated signal must align to next legal trading session open.

research_task._created_at_reason: Unexecuted candidate draft; physical creation timestamp will be recorded on task dispatch.

experiment_spec._task_content_hash_reason: Hash of upstream task is bound here (and included in spec hash calculation); null in unexecuted draft.
experiment_spec._spec_content_hash_reason: Spec hash excludes spec_content_hash itself; null in unexecuted draft.

dataset_target._target_comment: Candidate URI for walk-through only; does not imply warehouse exists in repository.

feature_specification.near_far_contract_selection_rule: Sort active contracts by contract_maturity_date ascending; near is earliest maturity with open_interest > threshold, far is subsequent maturity with open_interest > threshold. Do not assume main is earlier than sub_main.

target_specification._implementation_ref_status: candidate_unregistered_symbol; runner will reject execution if implementation is missing or unapproved

leakage_mitigation.purging_rule: Purge all training observations whose 20-day return intervals overlap with test evaluation windows (horizon=20 trading days).
leakage_mitigation.embargo_rationale: Candidate embargo buffer post-test to alleviate autoregressive residual spillover; does not eliminate all serial correlation.

metric_metadata.missing_reason: Unexecuted walk-through draft; all metrics strictly null.

unit_definitions.ic_pearson_cross_sectional: mean of daily cross-sectional Pearson correlation coefficients; sample_size=number of cross-sectional trading days T
unit_definitions.rank_ic_spearman_cross_sectional: mean of daily cross-sectional Spearman rank correlations; sample_size=T
unit_definitions.ic_ir_cross_sectional: dimensionless ratio (mean Rank IC / sample standard deviation of Rank IC)
unit_definitions.t_statistic_hac_adjusted: Newey-West HAC adjusted t-statistic accounting for autocorrelation induced by overlapping 20-day return horizon (lag=19)
unit_definitions.p_value_hac_adjusted: two-tailed p-value corresponding to HAC adjusted t-statistic in [0.0, 1.0]
unit_definitions.quantile_five_spread: raw 20-day forward log return sample mean of top quantile minus bottom quantile (decimal return spread, not annualized)

typed_metrics._forbidden_metrics_explanation: Pure statistical research strictly excludes trading backtest metrics (e.g. Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, total PnL) to maintain scientific demarcation.

result_evidence._metrics_policy: Unexecuted or mathematically undefined metrics are null. If executed, genuine zero observations are retained as 0.0.
